offered_contract.correlation: The caller selects one nonempty thread ID and turn ID. Events for other identities leave that selected reading unchanged. Empty caller identity means unobserved correlation, not a valid wildcard.
offered_contract.total: Cumulative thread usage. A present cumulative quantity retains its cumulative meaning across notifications.
offered_contract.last: Usage of the most recent model call, not another cumulative counter. Successive calls may have different sizes; decreasing last usage alone is not a cumulative regression.
offered_contract.input_partition: This reader defines uncached input as reported inputTokens minus reported cachedInputTokens. The latter is a subset of the former.
offered_contract.cache_writes: Report the optional cacheWriteInputTokens quantity separately. Its presence alone supplies no additive price rule or instruction to subtract it from uncached input. A missing quantity stays unknown.
offered_contract.scope: Reported token volume is not monetary cost. A cumulative snapshot is an observed prefix; notification count is not model-call count. Structural checks establish their covered cases.
